config_keys.policies_root: REQUIRED str - the OTHER root (coop3) holding the read-only checkpoints
config_keys.checkpoint_k: REQUIRED int >= 0 - the ONE pinned k for both arms (default for k_B/k_R)
config_keys.checkpoint_k_B / checkpoint_k_R: optional per-arm override; MUST agree, mismatch refuses
config_keys.checkpoint_sha256: REQUIRED {'B': hex64, 'R': hex64} - sha256 of coop3's B_checkpoint_<k>.pt / R_checkpoint_<k>.pt; mismatch refuses BEFORE any charge
config_keys.charge_route: REQUIRED dict; mode 'rpc' (DEFAULT): {run_root, q_host, q_control, q_python, q_pythonpath} (+ optional 'phases' list; default ['sumo_verification','bank_verification_ext']) - the ledger-host RPC binding the path charges through; mode 'local': {run_root, mode:'local'} - ONLY on the registered single ledger host (LEDGER_HOST.json binding at the run root), charging the unchanged accel_storage.reserve there; any other mode value refuses
config_keys.collect_id_prefix: REQUIRED str [a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40} - episode ids <prefix>_<arm>_k<k:03>_e<n:05d>_<seed>; never the historical hard-coded id
config_keys.episode_phase: REQUIRED str - the route phase episodes are charged in (must be registered on the route)
config_keys.runtime / accel_bounds / gpu_deadline /: REQUIRED - episode plant binding (as in every collector)
config_keys.extra_seeds: optional int >= 0 (DEFAULT 0 = off) - the live per_seed_v1 bank BUILD option: with all8 confirmations, plans carrying a within-seed cooperative example are additionally verified on CRN seeds 3..(2+extra_seeds); passed to rb.confirm_pending only as its registered extra_seeds kwarg
config_keys.broker: REQUIRED for arm B - single-slot config {amendment_sha256, gpu_deadline, workers:[{endpoint:{slot,destination,port,identity_file,known_hosts}, owner:{boot_id,pid,start_ticks}}], optional binding}; exactly ONE worker; the optional 'binding' is the operator-staged fresh-worker GPU binding snapshot (hashes MUST pin the variety sources pytools/tools/coopmwm/variety.py + niche_collect.py; any adopted_startup_gates content refuses)
config_keys.variety: optional - the registered variety_* keys (variety.split_config validates; families False/absent = legacy bytes)

what_it_does.pinned: pinned_checkpoints/pinned_policy load B_checkpoint_<k>.pt / R_checkpoint_<k>.pt from policies_root, sha256-checked against the staged config, payload update must equal k; k_B != k_R refuses; the collection root never stores or updates a policy
what_it_does.ledger_split: route_charges() installs the ONE-ledger charge route and refuses before anything runs. mode 'rpc' (default) probes the EXISTING cpuS->ledger-host RPC route with a read-only 'budget' op and refuses the whole path when unavailable; charges go through cpus_checking.install_remote_accounting with phases sumo_verification (window verifications), bank_verification_ext (confirmations) and the registered episode_phase. mode 'local' (MAIN 2026-11-04 16:2x ledger host move cpuQ->cpuS): allowed ONLY where socket.gethostname() equals the LEDGER_HOST.json 'host' registered at the ledger run root; charges go through the UNCHANGED accel_storage.reserve at the binding's ledger_path (which must equal the route run root) with the ledger root's own registered caps (warm_protocol.install_accounting) - the same single write point the ledger host's own cpus_rpc op_reserve uses. refuse_local_ledger guards the collection root against a second CHARGES.jsonl (file OR dir) at startup and after every round in BOTH modes
what_it_does.ledger_host_binding: LEDGER_HOST.json at the ledger run root registers the SINGLE ledger host: {host, ledger_path, authority_sha256} - authority_sha256 is the sha256 of the run root's AUTHORITY.md AUTHORITY line; a missing/incomplete/unknown-key/tampered/relocated binding refuses (ledger_host_binding), and mode 'local' on any other host refuses with 'not the registered single ledger host' (local_charges) - so there is never a second ledger
what_it_does.rpc_route: cpus_rpc.op_reserve gains an ADDITIVE binding key 'collect' {phases, id_prefixes}: registered collection ids (route_prefixes = [<prefix>_, sv_<prefix>_, confirm_replication_sv_<prefix>_, confirm_extended_sv_<prefix>_, confirm_solo_sv_<prefix>_]) charge the SAME ledger in the registered phases without consuming the all8 delegate allowance; without the key the binding stays all8-only with byte-identical refusal texts (tested)
what_it_does.gpu_worker_gates: the broker slot is admitted only when ALL 8 startup gates hotadd.GATES (hotadd.py:8-11 - the full fresh-worker startup set; hotadd.qualified refuses 'missing/nonexact new-worker gate') are present with pass_ true. broker_readiness() reads the worker's receipts; the warm_service.ADOPTABLE 4-gate subset never satisfies readiness (tested: 4-gate receipts -> ready False)
what_it_does.fresh_worker: FIX ROUND 2: the staged STAGE_WORKER.py has NO takeover mode at all. Starting it (operator, on the GPU host): refuses if <worker_root> already exists or carries any owner PID/lock file (SPOOL_OWNER.json, SERVICE_OWNER.json, SPOOL_WORKER.claim, SERVICE.claim, SPOOL_FAILED.json, SPOOL_STOP.json, LS_GPU_ORIGINALS.json, FRESH_DISPATCH.json) - it never adopts a running process and never sends any process a termination request (the module contains no ls_gpu import and no recover flag: 'no code path reaches recover=True' is asserted over module AND generated artifact); refuses a binding with adopted_startup_gates (a fresh worker RUNS the gates, never inherits them); refuses an overlay that lacks a hashed source, mismatches a sha256, or carries its own GPU_BINDING.json. Then it stages the NEW EMPTY root (exclusive mkdir; copytree of the worker-root-shaped overlay: run artifacts at top level, package tree under pytools/), re-verifies every binding hash in the copied tree, writes GPU_BINDING.json and starts the FRESH service CONFIG['fresh']['service'] = tools.coopmwm.warm_spool (cwd/PYTHONPATH = the worker root's own pytools, so the staged service module is the one that runs). warm_spool -> warm_service.main with NO adopted_startup_gates runs ALL EIGHT hotadd.GATES itself (WARM_BATCH_SINGLE K4/K8 + COMMITTED K4/K8 + PARITY K4/K8 + WARM_PARITY K4/K8) before plan_service announces READY. fresh_binding(broker) builds the binding when the operator staged none: hashes over this build's numerical python sources (warm_service.NUMERICAL coopmwm/coopnative set) PLUS the variety sources (pytools/tools/coopmwm/variety.py, pytools/tools/coopmwm/niche_collect.py - the GPU side re-derives the registered variety decision groups from these), refusing any missing source, plus the fresh 8-gate startup shape (memory_mode warm, startup_qualification, speed2, speed2_transfers, concurrent_plans, batch_width_by_K, deadline = broker gpu_deadline). The frozen external pieces (wmteach runtime, FROZEN_COSTS.json, INPUTS.json) stay the operator's established frozen staging responsibility; a staged broker 'binding' snapshot (e.g. taken from the qualified source root) may supply them and is validated (variety sources pinned, adopted gates refused, sha256 hex).
what_it_does.broker_admission: the slot is admitted to the broker ONLY after all 8 receipts pass: STAGE_WORKER.py --check prints ready=True only when EVERY gate named in STARTUP_GATES.json is present with pass_ true (exit 0; missing/failing/unparsable -> exit 2), and broker_readiness (the ls_collect_ops.collection_gpu_status readiness rule shape) gates the broker side identically - a missing OR failing gate keeps the slot unserved forever
what_it_does.confirmations_all8: FIX ROUND 2: collect() calls rb.confirm_pending(..., verify_mode='all8_both_seeds', extra_seeds=int(cfg['extra_seeds'])) EVERY round - the per-seed all8 verification (tools/coopmwm/verify_perseed.py, the live per_seed_v1 bank rule): every completed decision gets all K candidates + policy on the second CRN seed, per-seed winners, per-(plan, seed) solos; extra_seeds (config, default 0 = off) verifies cooperative plans on CRN seeds 3..(2+n) exactly as the live bank's binding option. The legacy single-replica confirm path is unreachable from this collector (tested: the all8 builder receives the call with the configured extra_seeds; default rounds pass extra_seeds=0)
what_it_does.r_waits_for_b: replay_bank.py:292 (verify_pending: matched = b_available_k(root) if arm == 'R') matches R decision i to B decision i of the same issue order index - BY DESIGN (fairness): R inherits the available_k of the corresponding B decision so both arms are verified at the same k, and R WAITS for B (verify_pending breaks with 'no unmatched B decision yet' until B's decision i exists; b_available_k reads B's decisions/links first). KEPT UNCHANGED this round; documented here because it means the R bank trails the B bank by construction - R never verifies a snapshot that has no B counterpart, so a stalled B bank stalls R verification (never a k asymmetry)
what_it_does.arm_b: collector_guide queues WM-search requests (root/requests) carrying search_config = the registered it2_K2 boundary config PLUS the variety keys, so the GPU side re-derives the same additive decision groups and takes exactly floor(variety_structured_share * population) structured slots (mppi_search; byte-covered by test_variety_cpu SearchIntegration)
what_it_does.arm_r: collector_guide queues centre-only requests (no WM scoring); rb.candidates_for draws sv.random_candidates with the snapshot meta's variety_config - each draw is Bernoulli(variety_structured_share) structured vs free (share 0.25 registered), identical registered keys as B
what_it_does.broker_config_only: stage_broker writes THREE artifacts into <root>/broker and starts NOTHING: BROKER_CONFIG.json (the validated single-slot config + the fresh section {binding, service}; on cpuS the operator installs it as <root>/LS_ENDPOINTS.json next to LS_RECOVERY_CONFIG.json - the exact shape ls_broker.run consumes), STARTUP_GATES.json (ALL 8 hotadd.GATES gate names that must be present with pass_ true before the slot is served), STAGE_WORKER.py (the generated worker staging script; '--check' prints readiness only, no --check starts the fresh service)

preflight_operator: 1. Stage this commit's source as the cpuS pytools overlay (same git-archive flow as cpuS checking; includes the plan-variety sources the GPU overlay needs).

2. LEDGER HOST (MAIN 16:2x: moving cpuQ -> cpuS): at the ledger run root register LEDGER_HOST.json = {host: socket.gethostname() of the ONE ledger host, ledger_path: the ledger run root path, authority_sha256: sha256 of the AUTHORITY.md AUTHORITY line}. Mode 'rpc' (default): extend the ledger host's RPC_BINDING.json ADDITIVELY with collect = {phases: [...], id_prefixes: varcollect.route_prefixes(config)} (default phases = ['sumo_verification','bank_verification_ext']; to charge episodes 'train' instead add 'train' to BOTH this list and the config's episode_phase; cpus_rpc runs one short process per call, so the next call reads the new binding; without the key nothing changes). Mode 'local': only runnable ON the registered host; charges use the unchanged accel_storage.reserve under the ledger root's own caps - no RPC binding needed for the collection path, and no second CHARGES.jsonl may exist anywhere else.

3. Create the NEW collection root (its NAME is a parameter) and write VARCOLLECT_CONFIG.json (validated by varcollect.split_config: unknown keys refuse). checkpoint_sha256 = sha256 of coop3's B_checkpoint_003.pt / R_checkpoint_003.pt; charge_route.run_root = the ONE shared ledger run root; add mode:'local' only for the registered ledger host itself.

4. Arm R: nice -n19 python -B -m tools.coopmwm.varcollect <root> --arm R (no broker needed; refuses immediately if the route is unavailable / the host is not the registered ledger host / the pinned k or sha mismatch).

5. Arm B: python -m tools.coopmwm.varcollect <root> --arm B stages the broker artifacts, then the OPERATOR (a) installs broker/BROKER_CONFIG.json as <root>/LS_ENDPOINTS.json + writes LS_RECOVERY_CONFIG.json (run_root=<root>, gpu_deadline, amendment_sha256, receipt_suffix), (b) FRESH WORKER on the GPU host: assemble the worker-root-shaped overlay directory (run artifacts at top level: INPUTS.json, FROZEN_COSTS.json, FROZEN_MOTION_SOURCE.py, the external wmteach runtime + the git-archive package tree under pytools/), then run 'python3 broker/STAGE_WORKER.py <NEW_empty_worker_root> --overlay <overlay_dir>' - it stages the NEW root + the binding (every hashed source sha256-checked against the overlay; the binding MUST pin the variety sources) and starts the FRESH warm_spool service, which itself RUNS all 8 hotadd.GATES before serving; poll readiness with '... --check' (exit 0 only when all 8 receipts pass_); NEVER point it at an existing worker root (it refuses: existing root or any owner PID/lock; it never adopts and never signals any process - there is no takeover mode), (c) start tools.coopmwm.ls_broker <root> on cpuS - the slot is admitted only once all 8 receipts pass (broker_readiness). THIS BUILD ssh'es and starts nothing.

6. Verify charges: ledger host CHARGES.jsonl rows (ids carry <prefix>_ / sv_<prefix>_ / confirm_*_sv_<prefix>_ and the all8 kinds confirm_seed2_all8 / confirm_extended_all8 / confirm_solo_all8_s*; in mode 'rpc' additionally <control>/CHARGES_RPC.jsonl rows with route='collect'); the collection root must contain NO CHARGES.jsonl.
how_to_run.stop: MAIN_STOP.json in the collection root stops the loop after the current round; budget-blocked statuses stop the rounds (charges retained, never retried blindly).
